GURPSITEMODERN.Settings.WindowSize.Name: Remember item sheet window size
GURPSITEMODERN.Settings.WindowSize.Hint: Stores the last item sheet window size for this client and restores it the next time an item sheet is opened.
GURPSITEMODERN.Settings.AutoCreateAmmo.H: When a ranged weapon item has a Shots value, a per-actor resource tracker is created for it. Disabling this only stops new trackers from being created.
GURPSITEMODERN.Settings.BlockWhenEmpty.H: If an ammunition tracker reaches zero, the ranged attack is not rolled until the weapon is reloaded.
GURPSITEMODERN.Settings.RespectExternalA: When GGA Ammunition & Resource Assistant runs its own firing workflow, do not spend ammunition twice.
GURPSITEMODERN.Ammo.NoReserve: No ammunition in the linked reserve
GURPSITEMODERN.Ammo.NotEnoughReserve: Reloaded only {loaded} of {needed} rounds; the reserve is empty
